name: United States (FDA)
about: Prescribing information in PLR format (21 CFR 201.56 and 201.57) and the older format (21 CFR 201.80), patient labelling (Medication Guide under 21 CFR 208, Patient Package Insert, Instructions for Use), and carton and container labels. The checks follow the regulations and FDA guidance listed below; where a check estimates or simplifies, its rule card says so.

watch.title: Patient Medication Information (PMI)
watch.text: FDA proposed a one-page Patient Medication Information sheet in May 2023 that would replace Medication Guides and most Patient Package Inserts. As of mid-2026 the rule is still proposed (FDA reconfirmed the existing Medication Guide requirements in a July 2026 information-collection notice). The app teaches it in lesson 6 and never flags its absence; a one-page PMI drill is planned for Phase 2.

watch.title: 12-digit NDC
watch.text: FDA has proposed moving to a uniform 12-digit National Drug Code. Until a final rule applies, the app checks the current 10-digit formats (4-4-2, 5-3-2 or 5-4-1).

watch.title: Interchangeability statements for biosimilars
watch.text: FDA has been revising how interchangeability is shown in biosimilar labelling. The biosimilar exercise arrives in Phase 2 and will be marked Watch until the policy settles.
